purpose: Input-conditional per-question ACS gating using only two source-model features and source OOF errors; compare against static C1
weights_source: five-fold stratified OOF errors, 200 rows per axis, class midpoint source-only training threshold, seed42 from existing research/evaluate_c1_source_oof.py

prospective_selection.filter: canonical exact-text overlap vs 300 anchors AND old SST2/CARER 600 items, minhash/token Jaccard audit independent

gate_algorithm.input_features: for each candidate new prompt, each SOURCE model activation projected into 300-anchor canonical point Ahat@unit(h-mu); normalize each source point separately for cosine
gate_algorithm.OOF_memory: same source-model representations of only 200 old train rows (per axis), each train row paired 200x2 binary OOF errors
gate_algorithm.similarity: average cosine similarity of two independently unit-normalized source canonical point vectors, no target-model feature/labels
gate_algorithm.neighbor_weights: uniform over top-32 nearest source TRAIN OOF rows by paired-input cosine, stable tie-break by SHA row order
gate_algorithm.local_error_coprobability: nearest 32 paired binary source-OOF error rows, sum outer-products /32
gate_algorithm.fallback: if denominator <=1e-12 use source-global correlated-error weight; no target label or dev performance adaptation
gate_algorithm.polarity: each source native signed axis positive-minus-negative on full old 200 training examples; projected without normalization in raw Eq4 weighted mean, final unit after averaging
gate_algorithm.target_output: target model's anchor-projected final-token activation dot per-example mixed unit behavior axis; source outputs only determine input-dependent mix

metrics.primary: AUROC per 3 target families x2 axes on new separate data
metrics.criterion: dynamic AUROC minus source_OOF_correlated_static >= +0.02, 6 cases report all
metrics.uncertainty: 999 paired stratified bootstrap resamples for dynamic minus static, seeded 73

limitations: The new IMDB train source shares a scenario name with 20 development anchors; exact/lexical disjointness audit is mandatory and semantic paraphrase audit may remain incomplete
Train-source OOF co-errors are a surrogate of transfer reliability not a theorem
The new validation examples come from publicly known corpora; independence is operational source separation, not proof of prior model nonexposure
Model/dataset license status and old V6 24 consumed identities are not yet fully attested
This is input-conditional two-source behavior-axis weighting, not dynamic quantization-bit allocation
